title: Face window: footage full bleed, his face in a rounded corner window
goal:
Fri 13 Nov 'Counting rat tails', 5-minute wide cut and later pieces (Krish, 10 Nov: "the 5-minute video probably needs my face in the corner"). Most of the cut is generated footage (1902 Hanoi, the 2026 office) at full bleed; his take shows as a small rounded window, and goes full frame for the hook, the turn to 'your company' and the close.

1. Beat `layout` gains `'WINDOW'`: slot 0 is the full-canvas plate or footage (tall 1080x1920, wide 1920x1080); his camera renders inside a window box: wide bottom right {left:1452, top:676, width:400, height:340}, tall bottom left {left:48, top:1250, width:330, height:420} (clear of the right rail and above the caption zone). Rounded corners 28 px, a 6 px cream keyline, the house hard shadow; his crop is a head-and-shoulders crop centred on the face (reuse the existing face crop helper if one exists, otherwise centre crop).
2. Beat gains optional `face: 'full' | 'window' | 'off'` (default 'window' on WINDOW beats). Between consecutive beats the camera eases between full frame and the window over 12 frames (fast out, soft settle, at most a small spring), never a cut or a dissolve of his face over his face.
3. `off` hides the window for the beat (used on the tailless rat and the TOKEN LEGEND slam) with a 6-frame scale-down exit and the same entry back.
4. Devices on a WINDOW beat get the full canvas minus the window box as their box, so nothing draws over his face.
contract: Read apps/renderer/src/engine/layouts/index.ts, FormatMaster.tsx and props.ts first; add WINDOW in exactly the literal syntax of the other layouts so scripts/velib/qc.py::_renderer_layouts() still parses it. Change nothing for SPLIT, STAGE, P1, P3, P6, F1, F3. packages/contracts production-spec gains the same layout value and the optional `face` field (schema_version stays 2, additive). compile.py, lint.py, qc.py accept WINDOW without changing behaviour for others; qc's mark-tile and cue-sync rules treat WINDOW as they treat STAGE. Colours only from config/ve/brand-tokens.json. Tests: apps/renderer/src/engine/layouts/window.test.ts (window boxes for both aspects; a device box never intersects the window; full->window easing reaches the window box by frame 12 and never overshoots it by more than 4%), engine.test.ts (a WINDOW beat with face 'off' validates; an unknown face value fails), tests/ve_window_test.py (_renderer_layouts() contains WINDOW; compile of fixtures/ve/my-test-19s/spec.json with one beat changed to WINDOW succeeds).
